description: Google Image search via Serper API. Returns image URLs, thumbnails, dimensions, and source pages. Use layout=gallery for a renderable visual grid (designers/moodboards). Always rich — never compacted.

link_resolution.description: Google result links beyond the top 3 may come back as google.com/goto redirects. "auto" (default): top 3 resolved, any leftover goto links get a search_id for resolve_links. "all": also resolve every link now (free, but adds ~30 s when goto links are present). "none": fastest, links exactly as Google returns them.

max_chars.description: Truncate response to this many characters (0 = no limit).

num_results.description: Results (1–20, default 10). Note: >10 results uses 2 Serper credits.

orientation.description: Aspect filter, client-side via W×H (images without dimensions are kept).

provider.description: Search backend: auto (failover chain), serper, tavily, brave, exa, firecrawl. Default: auto.

site.description: Restrict to domain (e.g. dribbble.com, behance.net, unsplash.com).

size.description: Filter by pixel dimensions, client-side via W×H (longest side: small <640, medium <1280, large <2000, xlarge ≥2000; images without dimensions are kept).

snippets_only.description: Return 1-line snippets only (token-saving for agents). Default: false.

verbosity.description: Output density: auto (server picks per audience), compact (~800 tokens, dev fast path), standard (KG+Box+10), full (everything, always for places/shopping/images/scholar). Default: auto.

name: search_images
